status_definitions.blocked: Work cannot pass until a stated external or prerequisite condition is satisfied.
status_definitions.deferred: The user or release authority explicitly accepted later delivery.
status_definitions.implemented: The implementation exists but has not yet passed every applicable release verification.
status_definitions.proposed: The requirement has a design but implementation has not started.
status_definitions.started: Some implementation or evidence exists but the requirement is incomplete.
status_definitions.superseded: A later evidenced requirement or design replaced this clause.
status_definitions.verified: The implementation has passed its declared deterministic check on the candidate snapshot.

truthfulness_rules: Authorization or acceptance is not implementation evidence and never counts as verified.
Implemented means the implementation exists but one or more candidate-level checks remain.
Verified requires an applicable deterministic receipt bound to the current candidate inputs.
Blocked identifies a stated prerequisite; deferred requires explicit user or release-authority acceptance.
No row claims qualified legal, accessibility-expert, third-party or final security assurance.
